purpose: Replace repository-visible static oracle dependence for strong capability claims with fresh synthetic fixtures whose oracle, generation seed, and commitment nonce remain outside worker-readable state.
audit_model: After scoring, an evaluator may optionally reveal the oracle and seal nonce; verify_bundle must reproduce the pre-run public commitment. Seed reveal is optional and may be retained separately for exact fixture regeneration.

runtime_storage_requirement.rule: Evaluator-only oracle/seed/nonce must reside in a control-owned store that scored workers cannot read. Do not place evaluator secrets in the worker branch, worker context packet, or any repository path available to the worker.
runtime_storage_requirement.authority_rule: The evaluator store confers no production execution authority.

claim_policy.hidden_ephemeral_or_externally_blinded: eligible for stronger capability claims after runtime isolation is validated
claim_policy.authoring_control_chat: never a scored worker for fixtures whose oracle it generated or inspected
